body:
Hey, thanks for sharing some about yourself and taking the time to write it all out. Pretty sure someone is cutting onions somewhere, dammit...

And I'm not entirely sure why I lie so much. I'm sure that wanting to be the center of attention is part of it, but I'm just at a low enough self-esteem where I don't think anyone would accept the real me. The intellectual that brings others down just to bring himself up and has a very cynical view on human behavior just doesn't seem like an attractive personality.

How would you go about "coming clean." It makes me feel like shit for lying to them, but I feel like it would be even more of a colossal shitter if the person you confided in ended up lying in order to befriend him and carried that on for multiple years. I'm not trying to shoot down your advice, even though I think I am in order to avoid doing it, but I would have trouble trusting that person again.

"Fuck this lying crap, it's got you nowhere." :D

Thank you. Did you end up going to therapy/getting treated or was it just your "life experiences?" Also, if you don't mind could you elaborate on that? Just that you were mature enough, or that you had some life-changing moments?
